title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B QAD Q4_0 on llama.cpp, RTX 3060 12 GB, full 131K context
slug_note: ~87 tok/s decode, ~1064 tok/s prefill on a 12 GB card with 16 GB RAM; MoE layers partly on the CPU.

variation.license: LFM Open License v1.0 (free for commercial use under $10M annual revenue)
variation.quant_detail: QAD Q4_0, 13.58 GB: Liquid's quantization-aware distilled build, trained to recover Q4_0 loss

engine.config: llama-server, 12 MoE layers on the CPU (--n-cpu-moe 12), 131K context, q8_0 KV cache, flash attention, reasoning on

requirements.notes: Builder: 11.6 of 12.3 GB VRAM used (94%), the rest in system RAM; 16 GB RAM on the box. memory_gb is an estimate: the 13.58 GB file plus KV cache.

offload.locator: post text: '94% VRAM (11.6/12.3 GB), the rest sits in system RAM' and config flag --n-cpu-moe 12
offload.note: Builder-stated: the expert weights of 12 MoE layers run from system RAM on the CPU; everything else is on the GPU (-ngl 99).

run.command: llama-server -m LFM2.5-24B-A2B-QAD-Q4_0.gguf -ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 12 -c 131072 -fa on --jinja -np 1 --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 --temp 0.1 --top-k 50 --top-p 1.0 --min-p 0.0 --repeat-penalty 1.05 --reasoning on

steps.text: Install llama.cpp (see Step 0 in Quick start).
Download LFM2.5-24B-A2B-QAD-Q4_0.gguf from the LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B-GGUF repository into the folder you run from.

llama-server -m LFM2.5-24B-A2B-QAD-Q4_0.gguf -ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 12 -c 131072 -fa on --jinja -np 1 --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 --temp 0.1 --top-k 50 --top-p 1.0 --min-p 0.0 --repeat-penalty 1.05 --reasoning on

measurements.context: ~87 tok/s decode at full 131K context window, RTX 3060 12 GB
VRAM in use: 94% (11.6/12.3 GB); the rest sits in system RAM

caveats: Single builder post on launch day; the prompt length behind the speed figures is not stated.
Needs about 16 GB of system RAM next to the card, because 12 MoE layers run on the CPU.
License is Liquid's LFM Open License v1.0, not Apache-2.0: commercial use is licensed only for organisations under $10M annual revenue.
Not recommended on its own for knowledge-heavy tasks (Liquid's card): pair it with retrieval or web search.
